reviews.t: Summers Eve has nothing on this
reviews.x: I wish I tried this stuff sooner. I tried their deodorant and it worked EVERYWHERE, which shocked me how I had 0 smell after wearing no socks in vans in arizona heat (for 8 hours). But I didn’t like how it didn’t prevent perspiration for my underarms, just smell.  Their technology is astounding. Just buy it, trust me. I can’t get through a workday without my down there having a scent at the end of the day. 2 days w/ no shower and it’s completely scentless. And weirdly it doesn’t dry like any oth

I rarely ever leave negative reviews but I believe in consumer choice.. To be fair, I love the deodorant scents but they need to keep working on the formula for this wash!!  I bought the sampler and the smell is white vinegar!  Vinegar does wear off when it dries.  I used it between my chest and broke out in a stinging/red rash ~ to boot within an hour of using, I was 'smelly'..  I will continue buying the deodorants but never again will I buy the wash.  I threw the rest out.. IF you decide to t

I bought the sampler not wanting to commit to one scent. Good thing I did. I don't care for the cucumber melon scent. The sandalwood smells generally as expected.  I haven't tried the other two. It takes less than they recommend to get my bath puff very sudsy. This is less thanni use for other mostly natural body washes i use. The suds feel nice and rinse off easily. I feel clean after in that I notice less residue or lingering scent than most body washes leave. I wish they made a citrus scented

reviews.t: This really keeps you fresh from shower to shower!
reviews.x: All those nooks and crannies that can get funky from sweat and no air circulation stays odor  free for up to three days and I love it. Nice fragrance choices including one with no scent if that is your choice. A bit pricey but worth it.

I bought the sampler pack so I could choose which scent works for my body. Usually I would bathe or shower, lotion and add a smell good lotion/perfume. After 30-60 mins in the 90 degree heat, I would need to start all over again. The freshness would die. Today was a new day!  First day I tried the body wash I noticed a difference in my scent. It was lighter and the freshness lasted even in the summer heat. My lady parts and arm pits are fresher and my overall body aroma is more pleasant. I’m sol
It really works especially for us older folk. This is a genius move by the creator because all soap doesn't get rid of body odor and most deodorant doesn’t work as well either. I'm a happy camper.

I like this product! It doesn’t make my skin squeak after use and the fragrance is not overpowering. My armpits have gotten better after using this as they were getting to be with a film from the last product I used. I buy this for all my friends as gifts now.
This stuff works! I have super sensitive skin and it’s not bothered at all by this soap. Feeling super clean!
Cleans pretty well. The scent of each one was very much the same. Not a refreshing smell. This purchase was ok, but not buying again. Not worth the money.

I was skeptical, and it took me awhile to agree to the price.  This set seemed like a great way to try all the scents without a huge commitment.  This stuff totally lives up to the hype.  It works!  I wished I bought a long time ago.  I've since bought several more products available, and waiting on delivery.  Peony is my fave scent so far, its a subtle scent.  Repeat customer for sure.
It was nice to find this on Amazon I bought it as a gift and my daughter loves it

I was really hopeful and in general don't write bad reviews but felt like I should in this case.  Since ordering and using Lume for the first time I learned mandelic acid smells plain awful. I ordered a deodorant cream and body wash sample pack.  I can tolerate the body wash only because I use my own body wash afterwards.  I have no idea if that defeats the purpose or not.  The deodorant cream however just never stops stinking.  It's trading one stink for another.  It does exactly as advertised

What can I say about Lume other than “just buy it” our summer has been crazy hot and Lume has withstood every test, from butt sweat, to breast sweat, arm pits and the in betweens!!! It WORKS! And I love it! I don't leave home without it!

reviews.t: Trying a new product that was partially sucessful was enjoyable.
reviews.x: Lume peony scent body wash worked well for me.  Cucumber melon did not work well, or maybe it was me.  I did not try the sandalwood.  The Unscented smelled to me like someone's dirty feet so I did not use it.  Was very disgusted by the scent.  I was hoping Lume would give me another option for showering daily with regular soap or body wash.  I will probably order more of the peony scent in the future.  Also  give the cucumber melon another try.  This has been a fun experiment for me and I just l

Thought this was just another pleasant body wash. Lots of hype so I tried it. HA! Was I wrong. Never felt more clean in my life….absolutely marveled all day over how good my skin felt, Worth every penny. It does go a long way, lathers nicely. I always use an exfoliating Buff Puff but this wash took my shower to new levels. My skin felt NEW. Try it once and you’ll never buy anything else.

This body wash lathers well & keeps me fresh without drying out my skin. The only thing is, it smells like the Magic Shave my father used to use! Lol that’s weird to me, but none of the scents lasts on the skin for very long, so I’m happy for that! It does not interfere with my scent of the day either! I will buy again.

Decided to try these body washes because I love the lumi deodorant. Glad I did. The unscented and peony were the two scents I  prefer.  I wish the other two scents were accurate one is MELON, not melon cucumber and I wish the sandalwood smelled like sandalwood. But my skin feels better than it has in years.

Seems ok for a body wash but a bit pricey. It should be noted that while the unscented has no sent added, it's not without scent. While the smell doesn't last long, some might find it unpleasant. I'm not sure which ingredients cause the scent. My skin is super sensitive so I have to be careful what I use. I've been perfectly fine with this. The cucumber melon has a pleasant scent. I haven't tried the others because I know I won't like their scent.

The soap works well and I'm happy with the purchase. The smell of the actual soaps (except unscented) is really odd and mildly unpleasant. But it isn't noticable after you use them and they did help keep my son from having stinky feet. All in all a great product.
The set allows me to choose which smell I want to use.  The next time I will purchase the larger one of the smell I like.
It does what it says. After my first shower with the body wash I felt cleaner and my skin seemed brighter and smoother.
This body wash is fantastic. It will keep your skin clean and odor free.

Sadly I'll be a one star and am wondering if I got the right product. They were sealed. I tried the unscented and had to hurry and shower again because I smelled like rotting onions (not my normal scent, lol). I opened the cucumber melon and it smelled like vinegar and bile with a bit of cucumber hand sanitizer scent. I'll try sandalwood next and was really hoping for the positives everyone else is talking about but am not optimistic. I have a teenaged son (say no more) and tried these before gi

Great for odor control! Love that it can be used all over the body. IT IS DRYING so dry skin people like myself be aware you will want a good moisturizer when you're done. Leaves me feeling fresh and clean, scents weren't too bold but leave a nice gentle sbtle fragrance behind, the scent free truly is scent free, like smelling water! It is pricey but a good option if trying to find a scent to go with before buying the also pricey bigger version. I would give it 5 stars but like I said it is quit

reviews.t: Not as good as I hoped
reviews.x: Just use raw apple cider vinegar. This stuff does not de-stink. Vinegar though? Magical from head to toe.

claims.text: Most reviewers say the product genuinely works, keeping them odor-free through heat, sweat, and long days.
Many reviewers praise the sampler pack as a good way to try multiple scents before committing.
A common complaint is that some scents smell unpleasant, like vinegar or otherwise off.
Several reviewers find the product pricey, though some consider it worth the cost.
Some reviewers report it cleans well and is gentle on sensitive skin, while a few say it dries out skin.
